recommendations.headline: Customer satisfaction during the call is the single biggest conversion lever (satisfied calls win 72% vs just 16% for neutral and 6% for dissatisfied), yet only 35% of calls (732/2111) achieve a 'satisfied' rating and price itself is discussed in just 30% of calls.
behaviour: Customers are heavy price-shoppers: 'price_shopper' (370) and 'comparing_quotes' (223) are top behaviours, and 12 competitors (JSW 55, Tata 40, Asian 22, Pragathi 22, Radiance 15 etc.) are actively mentioned.
Most calls stall in indecision: 962 of 2111 calls (45.6%) end as 'callback' vs only 413 (19.6%) as firm orders, and 'indecisive' behaviour is logged 132 times.
Technical questions dominate: 'needs_technical_help' (311) and 'technical_advice' need (344) show customers frequently ask about thickness, weight-per-foot, grade before buying.

Price is rarely even discussed - 1,471 of 2,111 calls (69.7%) show 'not_discussed' for price - yet 'price_high' is still the top objection (302 calls), suggesting price anxiety is unaddressed rather than resolved.
Repeat and bulk buyers are significant: 'repeat_buyer' (191) and 'bulk_buyer' (194) behaviours show an active base worth retaining, but 'loyal_to_us' is tagged only 17 times.
satisfaction: Satisfaction strongly predicts sales: win rate is 72% for satisfied calls vs 16% neutral and just 6% dissatisfied - call experience matters more than price.
Only 34.7% of calls (732/2111) are rated satisfied; the majority, 52.5% (1109), are merely neutral - a large pool that could convert with better handling.

Price is not the main blocker (price_blocker_pct is only 17%), yet 'too_high' price reactions (69) and 'price_high' objections (302) persist - pointing to communication/value gaps rather than true price resistance.
Rep execution gaps are frequent and likely driving the neutral/dissatisfied scores: 'slow_or_unclear_answer' (351), 'no_follow_up_fixed' (322), and 'no_quote_sent' (199) are the top missed actions.

conversion.title: Fix call clarity and follow-up discipline
conversion.evidence: 'slow_or_unclear_answer' (351) and 'no_follow_up_fixed' (322) are the two most common rep misses, and satisfaction gap (72% vs 16% win) shows this directly costs orders.
conversion.action: Train reps to give crisp, confident answers and always set a specific follow-up date/time before ending every call.

conversion.title: Always send a quote and ask for the order
conversion.evidence: 'no_quote_sent' (199) and 'didnt_ask_for_order' (198) are top missed actions; 'callback' is the outcome in 45.6% of calls.
conversion.action: Make it mandatory to send a written/WhatsApp quote within the call and explicitly ask for the order before hanging up.

conversion.title: Proactively resolve stock questions with alternatives
conversion.evidence: 'stock_availability' is both the #2 objection (287, win 26%) and #2 need (383); 'didnt_offer_alternative' missed 117 times.
conversion.action: Reps must check live stock before quoting and always offer the closest in-stock alternative color/thickness if the exact item is unavailable.

conversion.title: Lead price conversations earlier and with value framing
conversion.evidence: 69.7% of calls (1,471) never discuss price even though 'price_high' is the top objection (302) and 'didnt_highlight_value' was missed 73 times.
conversion.action: Coach reps to introduce indicative pricing/value points (brand, quality, service) proactively rather than waiting for the customer to ask.

conversion.title: Qualify 'unknown' segment callers fast
conversion.evidence: 'unknown' segment is 753 calls (36% of total) with only 25% win rate vs 40% for identified dealers.
conversion.action: Ask 2-3 quick qualifying questions (role, project, quantity) early in every call to route customers into the right segment and pitch.

conversion.title: Commit to realistic, tracked delivery dates
conversion.evidence: 'delivery_time' objection (170, win 26%) and 'fast_delivery' is the top customer need (395); several summaries show missed delivery promises.
conversion.action: Give one firm delivery date per order, log it, and have reps proactively update the customer before the promised date if there's any delay.

conversion.title: Streamline credit requests - they convert well
conversion.evidence: 'credit_terms' objection has the highest win rate (32%) among all objections despite being raised in only 63 calls; 'needs_credit' behaviour seen in 78 calls.
conversion.action: Train reps to clearly explain the credit process and route serious credit requests to management same-day instead of leaving them open.

offers.title: Tiered bulk-order package
offers.for_whom: Bulk buyers and large project orders
offers.why: 'bulk_buyer' behaviour logged 194 times and summaries show multiple 7-ton and 30,000-80,000 sq ft enquiries.

offers.title: Cutting, lipping and custom-fabrication service
offers.for_whom: Fabricators and contractors needing custom profiles
offers.why: 'cutting_processing' need (92) and several summaries mention lipping, flashing and crimp sheet drawing requests.

offers.title: Fast digital quote and color-card service
offers.why: Many customers explicitly ask for WhatsApp quotes, screenshots, or color cards before deciding; 'no_quote_sent' missed in 199 calls.

offers.title: Scheduled/consistent supply plan for regular dealers
offers.why: 'consistent_supply' need (108) and 'repeat_buyer' behaviour (191) suggest dealers value predictable stock over one-off deals.

offers.title: Sample and test-certificate pack on request
offers.why: 'samples' need (55), 'test_certificate' need (16) and 'quality_doubt' objection (83) show buyers want proof before committing.

offers.title: Coordinated site-delivery/logistics service
offers.for_whom: Builders, contractors and industrial customers with large orders
offers.why: 'site_delivery' need (87) and frequent questions about vehicle logistics and delivery timing in summaries.

loyalty.title: Priority stock reservation for repeat dealers
loyalty.how: Flag repeat/bulk buyers in CRM and give them first call on new stock arrivals.
loyalty.why: 'repeat_buyer' (191) and 'bulk_buyer' (194) are major behaviour segments but 'loyal_to_us' is tagged only 17 times, showing untapped loyalty potential.

loyalty.title: Referral recognition programme
loyalty.how: Formally track and reward dealers who refer new customers with non-price perks (e.g. priority service, early stock access).
loyalty.why: 'referral' behaviour appears 24 times and customers directly ask 'will I get any benefit for referring future orders?'

loyalty.title: Dedicated relationship contact for top dealers
loyalty.how: Assign a named rep/account owner who proactively calls with rate and stock updates.
loyalty.why: 'regular_updates' is a top need (168) and dealers represent 1,028 of 2,111 calls with the highest win rate (40%).

loyalty.title: Fast-track order processing lane
loyalty.how: Create an expedited order path (pre-verified GST/PAN, standing delivery address) for repeat and consistent-supply customers.
loyalty.why: 'consistent_supply' need (108) and repeated requests for same-day/urgent delivery (urgent_buyer behaviour, 220).

loyalty.title: Proactive quality assurance follow-up
loyalty.how: Send test certificates and quality documentation automatically with orders for returning customers.
loyalty.why: 'quality_assurance' need (106) and 'quality_doubt' objection (83) show quality reassurance builds repeat trust.

loyalty.title: After-sales check-in calls
loyalty.how: Call customers a few days after delivery to confirm satisfaction and resolve any issues before they escalate.
loyalty.why: 'after_sales_support' need (39) and dissatisfaction cases (178 calls, only 6% win rate) show unresolved issues hurt future business.

non_price_benefits.title: Strong technical guidance
non_price_benefits.why: 'needs_technical_help' (311) and 'technical_advice' need (344) are among the top needs - customers frequently ask about thickness, weight and grade specs.

non_price_benefits.title: Real-time stock transparency
non_price_benefits.why: 'stock_availability' is both the #2 need (383) and #2 objection (287), showing customers value knowing exactly what's available now.

non_price_benefits.title: Reliable delivery commitments
non_price_benefits.why: 'fast_delivery' is the top customer need (395) and 'delivery_time' is the #3 objection (170).

non_price_benefits.title: Authorised JSW distributor quality assurance
non_price_benefits.why: 'quality_doubt' objection (83) and frequent competitor comparisons (JSW mentioned 55 times) show quality/brand trust is a key decision factor.

non_price_benefits.title: Customization and fabrication support
non_price_benefits.why: 'cutting_processing' need (92) and multiple summaries on custom lipping/flashing/profile drawings show added-value service matters.

non_price_benefits.title: Consistent, ongoing supply relationship
non_price_benefits.why: 'consistent_supply' need (108) reflects dealer preference for dependable long-term sourcing over one-off transactions.

top_questions.question: What is today's/current rate for [sheet/coil/screw product]?
top_questions.answer_tip: Keep an always-updated rate reference on hand and quote confidently without delay or vague answers.

top_questions.question: Is [color/thickness/size] in stock?
top_questions.answer_tip: Check live stock before answering; if unavailable, immediately offer the nearest available alternative.

top_questions.question: How many days will delivery take / will it reach today?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give one specific, realistic delivery date based on quantity and location, and proactively update the customer if it changes.

top_questions.question: Can I get credit instead of cash / extend payment terms?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain standard credit process clearly and escalate special requests to management the same day rather than leaving it open.

top_questions.question: Can you send the price list/quote on WhatsApp?
top_questions.answer_tip: Send the quote during or immediately after the call - do not leave this for a later follow-up.

top_questions.question: What is the weight per foot / thickness difference between Color On Plus and Silver On?
top_questions.answer_tip: Reps should know core technical specs cold or have a quick-reference chart to answer instantly.

top_questions.question: Why is your price higher than [competitor]'s rate?
top_questions.answer_tip: Redirect to quality assurance, authorised distributorship, consistent supply and service reliability rather than matching price on the spot.

top_questions.question: Will I get any benefit for referring other customers?
top_questions.answer_tip: Acknowledge the referral, note it for the proposed referral recognition programme, and follow up with a thank-you/benefit once formalised.
